pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with soft-to-moderate edge gradients; spatial area is maximal on the central flank and decreases in scale toward the lower neck and extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous lattice of light-colored pathways with relatively uniform pixel thickness; junction nodes typically represent the convergence of three to four pathways.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane extending from the cervical region to the shoulder, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several dark, linear textural disruptions and localized spots are visible on the lower posterior flank and ventral region.
